parameters.jsCode: const headers=$json.headers??{}; const body=$json.body??$json; const secret=headers['x-agent-secret']||headers['X-Agent-Secret']||body.agent_secret||''; if (!secret) { throw new Error('Missing x-agent-secret for callable workflow'); } return [{json:{...body,agent_secret:secret,mode:body.mode||'dry_run'}}];

parameters.query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_approvals WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND approval_stage='final_delivery' AND decision='approved' AND reviewer_type='human') AS final_human_approved;

INSERT INTO content_outputs (job_id, output_type, title, structured_data, qa_status) VALUES (NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid, 'delivery_pack', 'Human-approved delivery pack', jsonb_build_object('delivery_ready',true,'generated_after_human_approval',true), 'passed');
UPDATE content_jobs SET status='delivery_ready', updated_at=now() WHERE id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid;
